review.notes: Re-read all exact questions against individual rationales after assessment. Corrected planned Indigenous events to an implemented national observance; added August 2026 unilateral tariff evidence; confirmed ordinary import VAT against domestic VAT and changed the gender-pay-gap answer to a supported mixed position; withdrew the language-convention inference; distinguished arms reduction from a freeze; added the environmental approval rule. Sources distinguish laws in force from plans, temporary administration from ownership, temporary-residence quotas from permanent quotas, and older incumbent decisions from new 2026 action. Regional MCHS temperament/stress guidance and historical PTSD clinical guidance support only narrow domain inferences; neither education nor traditionalism establishes heredity. Review priorities for the independent agent: culture-nature 04/11/12 institutional scope and PTSD guideline currency; innovation-caution 12 strength of AI validation relative to cross-group reliability; secular-religious 08 status of advisory church review; nationalism-internationalism 09 scope of Union State coordination. Flag Commons File page, credited author and public-domain grounds checked, PNG visually inspected. This review is by the author, not an independent audit. The profile validator reports only the 36 unresolved entries (72 expected unresolved/unknown errors), no other errors or warnings. Source records with only a known month/year use undated rather than inventing publication days. The verified PNG is 960 by 640 pixels and 1,077 bytes. Similarity was not computed because the draft is incomplete. Independent review, shared image credit integration, archive and catalogue generation remain for the parent workflow. Separate completion challenge 2026-10-05: reread each new estimate against literal wording and earlier reasons for withdrawing exact attribution. Formal election-commission approval is distinguished from genuinely independent approval; judicial dependence does not prove an exact indefinite-detention rule. Military AI control is not per-strike approval. New regional waste evidence strengthens the private-contract estimate but is not nationwide ownership proof. Public-housing provision remains a provisional substantial-share estimate, not a measured stock proportion. Religious funding is qualified by unresolved budget purposes. Traditional values and gender restrictions do not themselves establish linguistic usage, dress, reform pace or biological causal beliefs. Reclassified temperament as an educated assumption because innate is not identical to inherited. Retained clinical interaction estimates as domain-scoped; no new proof of nationwide adoption or renewed guideline currency is claimed. Neutral entries on privatisation, benefit-tax tradeoff, climate priorities and sex behaviour express substantive competing mechanisms. Earlier full same-agent review retained; no independent human or second-agent review claimed.
